issues.description: Method parameter mismatch for addGuestStudents: the problem statement, UML and the solution implement a single-parameter method addGuestStudents(int) (solution: "public void addGuestStudents(int numberOfNewGuestStudents)"), but the template declares a two-parameter method "public void addGuestStudents(int numberOfNewGuestStudents, boolean validateInput)". This extra boolean parameter in the template changes the public API and will cause compilation errors or test failures when callers/tests expect the single-argument signature, and it will confuse students about which signature to implement.
